lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters is visible on the lateral flank, organized into three distinct horizontal rows with approximately uniform spacing between adjacent nodes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a structural grid where the circular blobs serve as anchor nodes at the points of intersection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity (high-luminance upper edge, shadowed lower edge) extending towards the caudal region.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, low-contrast luminance clusters is visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily located in the lower-central region of the fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin exhibits a jagged, non-linear contour consistent with physical trauma or an amputation notch.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density, stochastic speckling pattern of small luminance points that contrasts with the geometric grid-like arrangement on the main flank.
